_doc: Stream C (owner feedback 10). Thousandvale's own combat knobs that Farhold has no row for; read by js/rules/combat-cfg.js (engine.combatCfg; a parity engine has none and keeps Farhold's behaviour). `melee.foldSplash` (Y9): true = an enemy a melee swing's arc hits is struck ONCE, with the share Farhold's 'splash behind the arc' would have added folded into that one hit; only enemies the arc missed take a separate splash hit. `moving` (Y7): the rate multiplier of a basic attack made while the attacker is moving, per attack kind (melee | arrow | bolt | staff | form); 1 = full rate. `speed` (Y26): `capPct` = the most attack speed all bonuses together may give, `floorPct` the most a penalty may take; `ranged` / `staff` / `caster` true = haste also quickens a bow's draw, a staff's cast and a wand's or tome's bolt. `sight` (Y10): walls block attacks in an instance — `step` metres between samples along the line, `skip` metres ignored at each end (a body hugging a wall), `ttl` seconds a cached answer lives (a gate may open). `knockInterrupt` (Y12): the chance a knockback ends a monster's wind-up, by rank; `minPush` = the least knock in metres that counts. `dummy` (Y17): a training dummy's health as a multiple of an ordinary monster's of its level, the seconds after the last hit before it is whole again, and the body its armour is copied from. `wanderer` (Y21): a wilderness NPC that fights — built by js/rules/guards.js on the guards' reference body: `hpMult` / `dmgMult` on top of a guard's numbers, `playerM` = it only fights while a player is this close, `noticeM` = it takes on monsters this close to it, `leashM`, `respawnSec` down before it stands up, `savedBelow` = the share of health under which helping it counts as saving it, `helpedShare` = the least share of its foes' health a player must have dealt to be thanked.
